label_sources.val: churches.json (FullDataset with filter_labeled=True, as in training)

alignment_source: recomputed with analyze_q2_metrics.compute_model_metric_values on whole-image input; metrics.db not read
classification_input: native processor (center crop for dinov2, clip; full-image resize for the others)
frozen_definition: accuracy from the linear-probe checkpoint (frozen backbone + trained 4-class head); alignment from the frozen backbone (create_model)

test.name: Mann-Whitney U
test.groups: correct versus wrong images, native input view, per run and metric
test.correction: holm across runs, per metric; runs without an applicable test excluded
test.rank_biserial: 2U/(n_correct*n_wrong) - 1; positive means correct images have higher values

full_image_robustness.input_view: FineTunableModel.preprocess (whole image resized to 224x224, no crop)
full_image_robustness.alternate_family: native runs of the other models plus the full_image runs, which replace their native counterparts
